reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Missouri
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant based on their marital status?
*/

% -------------------------
% Basic domain vocabulary
% -------------------------

state(missouri).
focus_year(2021).

% A dwelling is housing covered by MO Rev Stat  213.040 (2021) prohibitions.
dwelling(D) :- residential_property(D).

% Eviction is treated as making a dwelling "otherwise ... unavailable" or denying it.
housing_action(evict).
housing_action(refuse_to_rent).
housing_action(discriminate_terms_conditions).
housing_action(advertise_preference).
housing_action(misrepresent_availability).
housing_action(blockbusting).

% -------------------------
% Statute encoding: MO Rev Stat  213.040 (2021)
% Unlawful housing practices (protected classes list).
% -------------------------

%  213.040.1 protected bases (note: marital status is NOT listed).
protected_basis_213040(race).
protected_basis_213040(color).
protected_basis_213040(religion).
protected_basis_213040(national_origin).
protected_basis_213040(ancestry).
protected_basis_213040(sex).
protected_basis_213040(disability).
protected_basis_213040(familial_status).

%  213.040.1(1): refuse to rent / deny / otherwise make unavailable because of protected basis.
statute_213040_unlawful_practice(Actor, deny_or_make_unavailable, Person, Dwelling, Basis) :-
    landlord(Actor),
    tenant(Person),
    dwelling(Dwelling),
    protected_basis_213040(Basis),
    because_of(Actor, Person, Basis),
    \+ statute_213040_exception_applies(Actor, Person, Dwelling, Basis).

%  213.040.1(2): discriminate in terms/conditions/privileges because of protected basis.
statute_213040_unlawful_practice(Actor, discriminate_terms_conditions, Person, Dwelling, Basis) :-
    landlord(Actor),
    tenant(Person),
    dwelling(Dwelling),
    protected_basis_213040(Basis),
    because_of(Actor, Person, Basis),
    \+ statute_213040_exception_applies(Actor, Person, Dwelling, Basis).

% Map eviction into the statute's "otherwise make unavailable / deny" concept.
eviction_counts_as_deny_or_make_unavailable(evict).

% Derived: eviction is unlawful under 213.040 if eviction is because of a protected basis.
statute_213040_unlawful_eviction(Actor, Person, Dwelling, Basis) :-
    eviction_counts_as_deny_or_make_unavailable(evict),
    eviction_attempt(Actor, Person, Dwelling),
    statute_213040_unlawful_practice(Actor, deny_or_make_unavailable, Person, Dwelling, Basis).

% ---- Exceptions & limitations mentioned in  213.040 (encoded in a minimal way) ----

%  213.040.7: direct threat / substantial property damage exception.
statute_213040_exception_applies(_Actor, Person, _Dwelling, _Basis) :-
    direct_threat_to_health_or_safety(Person), !.
statute_213040_exception_applies(_Actor, Person, _Dwelling, _Basis) :-
    substantial_physical_damage_risk(Person), !.

%  213.040.11: controlled substances manufacture/distribution conviction.
statute_213040_exception_applies(_Actor, Person, _Dwelling, _Basis) :-
    convicted_illegal_manufacture_or_distribution_controlled_substance(Person), !.

%  213.040.12: religious organizations / private clubs (scope limitation).
statute_213040_exception_applies(Actor, _Person, _Dwelling, _Basis) :-
    religious_organization_housing_provider(Actor),
    limits_to_same_religion(Actor),
    \+ religion_membership_restricted_by_race_color_or_national_origin(Actor), !.
statute_213040_exception_applies(Actor, _Person, _Dwelling, _Basis) :-
    private_club_not_open_to_public(Actor),
    lodging_incident_to_primary_purpose(Actor), !.

%  213.040.13: certain small-owner / owner-occupied exemptions (other than advertising).
statute_213040_exception_applies(Actor, _Person, Dwelling, _Basis) :-
    exempt_private_individual_single_family_sale_or_rental(Actor, Dwelling), !.
statute_213040_exception_applies(Actor, _Person, Dwelling, _Basis) :-
    exempt_owner_occupied_small_multi_family(Actor, Dwelling), !.

% -------------------------
% Statute encoding: MO Rev Stat  441.920 (2021)
% No eviction based on DV/SA/stalking victim status (residential properties only).
% -------------------------

%  441.920.2: no tenant shall be evicted on basis of being a victim (if otherwise qualifies),
% unless tenant allowed perpetrator in or landlord reasonably believes threat exists.
statute_441920_unlawful_eviction_due_to_victim_status(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    residential_property(Dwelling),
    eviction_attempt(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling),
    victim_status_basis(Tenant),                 % "on the basis of or as a direct result"
    otherwise_qualifies_for_tenancy(Tenant, Dwelling),
    \+ statute_441920_exception_applies(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling).

victim_status_basis(Tenant) :-
    victim_of_domestic_violence(Tenant), !.
victim_status_basis(Tenant) :-
    victim_of_sexual_assault(Tenant), !.
victim_status_basis(Tenant) :-
    victim_of_stalking(Tenant), !.
victim_status_basis(Tenant) :-
    imminent_danger_becoming_victim(Tenant), !.

statute_441920_exception_applies(_Landlord, Tenant, _Dwelling) :-
    tenant_allowed_named_person_into_premises(Tenant), !.
statute_441920_exception_applies(Landlord, _Tenant, _Dwelling) :-
    landlord_reasonably_believes_named_person_threatens_occupants_or_property(Landlord), !.

% -------------------------
% Scenario facts (the question's factual statement)
% "Evict a tenant based on their marital status"
% -------------------------

% Parties and property
landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).
residential_property(d1).

% A lease/tenancy relationship (minimal facts for context)
tenancy(t1, d1, l1).

% Eviction attempt
eviction_attempt(l1, t1, d1).

% The landlord's stated basis for eviction: marital status.
% We encode "because of marital status" as the causal reason used by statute predicates.
because_of(l1, t1, marital_status).

% Tenant attribute (not legally required by the statutes, but expresses the scenario)
tenant_attribute(t1, marital_status, divorced).

% Scenario helper predicate required by the prompt:
% Succeeds when the encoded factual statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    residential_property(d1),
    tenancy(t1, d1, l1),
    eviction_attempt(l1, t1, d1),
    because_of(l1, t1, marital_status),
    tenant_attribute(t1, marital_status, _AnyStatus).

% -------------------------
% Defaults / "closed world" helpers for exception-related facts
% (No such exceptions are asserted in this scenario.)
% -------------------------

direct_threat_to_health_or_safety(_Person) :- fail.
substantial_physical_damage_risk(_Person) :- fail.
convicted_illegal_manufacture_or_distribution_controlled_substance(_Person) :- fail.

religious_organization_housing_provider(_Actor) :- fail.
limits_to_same_religion(_Actor) :- fail.
religion_membership_restricted_by_race_color_or_national_origin(_Actor) :- fail.

private_club_not_open_to_public(_Actor) :- fail.
lodging_incident_to_primary_purpose(_Actor) :- fail.

exempt_private_individual_single_family_sale_or_rental(_Actor, _Dwelling) :- fail.
exempt_owner_occupied_small_multi_family(_Actor, _Dwelling) :- fail.

victim_of_domestic_violence(_Tenant) :- fail.
victim_of_sexual_assault(_Tenant) :- fail.
victim_of_stalking(_Tenant) :- fail.
imminent_danger_becoming_victim(_Tenant) :- fail.
otherwise_qualifies_for_tenancy(_Tenant, _Dwelling) :- fail.
tenant_allowed_named_person_into_premises(_Tenant) :- fail.
landlord_reasonably_believes_named_person_threatens_occupants_or_property(_Landlord) :- fail.

% -------------------------
% Reasoning + Answer
% -------------------------

% "Unlawful to evict based on marital status?" under the encoded MO statutes.
% We answer "yes" only if some encoded statute makes this eviction unlawful on these facts.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    (
        statute_213040_unlawful_eviction(l1, t1, d1, _Basis)  % would require a protected basis
    ;
        statute_441920_unlawful_eviction_due_to_victim_status(l1, t1, d1)
    ),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant based on their marital status?
